scenes: Prosecutors say he paid eighty thousand dollars for a murder... and the hitman was a cop.
Ross Ull-brick ran Silk Road, the biggest dark web market on Earth.
He believed a worker stole his bitcoin, so he hired a hitman called Nob.
Nob was a D E A agent. The photos were staged. The victim was alive.
On October second, twenty thirteen, the F B I shut Silk Road down and bitcoin crashed to eighty-five dollars.
He got life in prison. And the agent who stole the coins? He went to prison too.
